fusions.name: Rivet Gnaw
fusions.desc: A bite at the joints that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Under the Plates
fusions.desc: Sends locusts crawling through a cone 4 tiles ahead of you, dealing 30 damage to everything in it. It ignores armour.

fusions.name: Interlocked Husks
fusions.desc: Locks shed husks into a shell that absorbs the next 20 damage and holds for 8 seconds. For 6 seconds, an escort of locusts fights beside you, striking for 5 damage every 1.6 seconds.

fusions.name: Salvaged Scale
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 3% of your maximum health per stack (17% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
